resources.string: Take or choose a photo of a page ruined by glare, shadow or poor light. Arcalume evens out the lighting, restores faded text, marks every pixel it had to fill, and keeps the untouched original.
Everything stays on this phone. Arcalume has no internet access, no account and no tracking.
Hold the phone flat over the page with the whole page in view. If you see a bright spot, tilt the phone a little and take another photo.

Arcalume does not request internet access. Photos, vaults and the custody log are stored only in this app\'s private storage and are excluded from cloud backups. Nothing leaves the phone unless you export it.
Text inside a blown-out glare spot is gone from the photo. Arcalume fills that area smoothly and marks it; it never invents characters. Retake the photo at an angle instead.
The custody log proves that records were not changed after sealing. It can\'t prove what happened to a photo before it reached Arcalume, and it is not a certification that evidence is admissible.
Reading order is geometry: it finds columns and blocks. It does not read or understand the text.
Arcalume uses OpenCV (Apache License 2.0), Bouncy Castle (MIT License), and Android Jetpack libraries (Apache License 2.0).

Add the photos, screenshots, documents and message exports you want a judge to see. Arcalume numbers them as exhibits, shows what each file\'s hidden metadata says, records every step in a tamper-evident log, and turns them into a printable exhibit packet. Nothing leaves this phone.
Files are kept exactly as they are. You can also share to \"Add to Arcalume case\" from WhatsApp, Gallery, Files or a mail app.
How to add text messages and chats

WhatsApp: open the chat, tap the three dots, then More, then Export chat. Choose Without media (or Include media), and pick \"Add to Arcalume case\". The packet prints every message in time order with the sender.
Text messages: back them up with the SMS Backup & Restore app to an XML file, then add that file here. Arcalume reads the file on the phone; it never reads your messages directly.

The exhibit packet is one PDF with a cover page, an index, a chronology, every exhibit with its fingerprint and metadata, page stamps, and a declaration you can sign. The verification bundle is a ZIP of the untouched originals with their fingerprints and the custody log, so anyone can check the packet.
The free plan prints the first %1$d exhibits. Pro prints all of them and adds the verification bundle.
